prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single “best” AI video ad maker for everyone — the right tool depends on your goal (talking‑head ads, short social clips, e‑commerce product videos, repurposing long content), budget, and how much customization you need. That said, a few platforms consistently stand out:

Top picks and when to use them
- Synthesia / HeyGen — Best for polished talking‑head ads with AI presenters. Great when you want a humanlike spokesperson in many languages without casting, filming, or studio costs.
- Pictory — Best for turning scripts or long-form content into short social ads. Strong at automatic highlights, captions, and fast editing for multiple formats.
- InVideo / Promo.com / VEED — Best for template-driven social and product ads. Fast, large template libraries, easy branding and CTA placement; good for marketers who want speed and polish.
- Runway / Descript — Best for creative, high‑control editing plus generative visual/voice tools. Use when you need advanced editing, generative backgrounds, or sophisticated cuts/visual effects.
- Opus Clip / Vidyo.ai — Best for repurposing long videos (webinars, streams, podcasts) into short, platform-optimized ads automatically.
- CapCut / Clipchamp — Best budget/DIY options for quick mobile/social ads; good if you’re comfortable doing more manual edits.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Primary format: talking head, animated text, product demo, repurposed clip?
- Platforms & aspect ratios: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Stories, Reels?
- Required realism: realistic AI presenter vs stylized templates/animations?
- Languages & voices needed
- Brand controls: custom fonts, colors, logo, approved assets
- Output resolution, watermark policy, commercial rights
- Budget and team workflow (collaboration/enterprise features, user seats)

Practical recommendation
- If you want a presenter-style ad: try Synthesia or HeyGen (they’re fast and widely used).
- If you need quick social ads from scripts or long videos: try Pictory or Opus Clip.
- If you want templates + e‑commerce focus: try Promo.com, InVideo, or VEED.
- If you want cutting-edge creative control: try Runway or Descript.

Next steps
1) Pick 2 tools that match your use case and sign up for trials/free tiers.  
2) Make a 15–30 second test ad and export in your target aspect ratios.  
3) A/B test variants and measure CTR/CPA — the platform that produces better conversions for your audience is “best” for you.

If you tell me what kind of product, target platform, budget, and whether you need an AI spokesperson, I can recommend 2–3 specific providers and a quick workflow for producing a test ad.
